Before it changed anything it showed me the overlap plainly — that 14 of the links in the file are ones I already have — and spelled out what it would do: not make second copies of those 14, leave the titles and descriptions I'd already tweaked untouched, and only add any new folder-labels from the file onto those existing bookmarks. That's precisely what I'd want when importing on top of a library I've already started tidying: no duplicates, my own edits protected, but I still get the benefit of any new labels. And the 233 genuinely new ones come in as before. Settled — importing into a library that isn't empty behaves just how I'd hope.
